mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_schedule ( schedule_no, queue_id, student_id, counselor_id, assistant_id, consultation_date, slot_id, room_id, session_no, source_type, schedule_status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{scheduleNo}, #{queueId}, #{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{assistantId}, #{consultationDate}, #{slotId}, #{roomId}, #{sessionNo}, #{sourceType}, #{scheduleStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_schedule SET schedule_status = #{scheduleStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_schedule WHERE schedule_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

sql.if: AND (su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.studentKeyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.studentKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT cs.id, cs.schedule_no, cs.queue_id, cs.student_id, su.real_name AS student_name, sp.student_no, cs.counselor_id, counselor_su.real_name AS counselor_name, cs.assistant_id, assistant_su.real_name AS assistant_name, cs.consultation_date, cs.slot_id, ts.slot_name, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, cs.room_id, cr.room_name, cs.session_no, cs.schedule_status, cs.create_time FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN staff_profile csp ON cs.counselor_id = csp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user counselor_su ON csp.user_id = counselor_su.id LEFT JOIN staff_profile asp ON cs.assistant_id = asp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user assistant_su ON asp.user_id = assistant_su.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON cs.slot_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN counseling_room cr ON cs.room_id = cr.id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cs.consultation_date DESC, ts.start_time ASC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT cs.id, cs.schedule_no, cs.queue_id, cs.student_id, su.real_name AS student_name, sp.student_no, cs.counselor_id, counselor_su.real_name AS counselor_name, cs.assistant_id, assistant_su.real_name AS assistant_name, cs.consultation_date, cs.slot_id, ts.slot_name, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, cs.room_id, cr.room_name, cs.session_no, cs.schedule_status, cs.create_time FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN staff_profile csp ON cs.counselor_id = csp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user counselor_su ON csp.user_id = counselor_su.id LEFT JOIN staff_profile asp ON cs.assistant_id = asp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user assistant_su ON asp.user_id = assistant_su.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON cs.slot_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN counseling_room cr ON cs.room_id = cr.id WHERE cs.queue_id = #{queueId} ORDER BY cs.consultation_date DESC, ts.start_time ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT cs.id, cs.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, cs.student_id AS studentId, su.real_name AS studentName, sp.student_no AS studentNo, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, COALESCE(cq.problem_type_id, fvr.problem_type_id) AS problemTypeId, pt.type_name AS problemTypeLabel, COALESCE(cq.crisis_level, fvr.crisis_level) AS crisisLevel, cs.consultation_date AS consultationDate, ts.slot_name AS slotName, ts.start_time AS startTime, ts.end_time AS endTime, cr.room_name AS roomName, cs.session_no AS sessionIndex, cs.schedule_status AS status, cs.counselor_id AS counselorId, counselor_su.real_name AS counselorName, fvr.summary AS firstVisitSummary, fvr.next_action AS nextAction FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN consultation_queue cq ON cs.queue_id = cq.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_result fvr ON cq.first_visit_result_id = fvr.id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON COALESCE(cq.problem_type_id, fvr.problem_type_id) = pt.id LEFT JOIN staff_profile csp ON cs.counselor_id = csp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user counselor_su ON csp.user_id = counselor_su.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON cs.slot_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN counseling_room cr ON cs.room_id = cr.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY cs.consultation_date ASC, ts.start_time ASC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN consultation_queue cq ON cs.queue_id = cq.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_result fvr ON cq.first_visit_result_id = fvr.id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON COALESCE(cq.problem_type_id, fvr.problem_type_id) = pt.id
